text:
## Template 19: Unrecognized Login Alert  
**Trigger:** Login from new device or location  
```
FirstUK: Login attempt on [date] [time] from [location/device].
If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or
call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
```  
*Character count: ~160*  
---
name: Chunk 21/24

raw_entities.name: Unrecognized Login Alert
raw_entities.description: A security alert template triggered when a login attempt is detected from a new device or location. The message notifies the customer of the login attempt with date, time, and location/device details, and instructs them to change their password immediately or contact the fraud line if the login was unauthorized.
context: Template 19: Unrecognized Login Alert
Trigger: Login from new device or location
If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.

raw_entities.name: Login Attempt Date
raw_entities.description: The date on which the unrecognized login attempt occurred, inserted dynamically into the alert message.
context: Login attempt on [date] [time] from [location/device].

raw_entities.name: Login Attempt Time
raw_entities.description: The time at which the unrecognized login attempt occurred, inserted dynamically into the alert message.
context: Login attempt on [date] [time] from [location/device].

raw_entities.name: Login Location or Device
raw_entities.description: The geographic location or device identifier from which the login attempt was made, inserted dynamically into the alert message to help the customer identify whether the access was authorized.
context: Login attempt on [date] [time] from [location/device].

raw_entities.name: Unrecognized Login Attempt Detection
raw_entities.description: A fraud detection alert generated when a login is attempted from a new device or location not previously associated with the customer account. The alert triggers an automated security notification to the customer with instructions to verify the login or reset their password.
context: Trigger: Login from new device or location
If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.

raw_entities.name: Password Reset Requirement on Unrecognized Login
raw_entities.description: The customer must change their password immediately if they do not recognize the login attempt from a new device or location. This is a security control obligation communicated through the alert template.
context: If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Line Contact Obligation on Unauthorized Login
raw_entities.description: The customer must contact the fraud line at 0800-555-2265 if they do not recognize the login attempt, enabling the bank to investigate and take protective action on the account.
context: If not you, change password immediately: www.firstuk.bank/reset or call 0800-555-2265 fraud line.
